Vault12 Guard review: digital legacy verdict

By the Afterkeep research team · Reviewed on 15 Oct 2026

Verdict: Backs up seed phrases using trusted 'Guardians' and lets you name a beneficiary who can inherit after a 48-hour owner veto window and Guardian approvals. Best for: Self-custody users with many wallets who don't want a seed phrase stored in one place.

Key facts

  • Category: Crypto inheritance
  • Pricing: Check current pricing.
  • Best for: Self-custody users with many wallets who don't want a seed phrase stored in one place.
  • Works with any blockchain and wallet
  • Guardians hold encrypted shards, not the full seed

Official site ↗ Legacy feature docs ↗

What are the pros and cons of Vault12 Guard?

Pros

  • Works with any blockchain and wallet
  • Guardians hold encrypted shards, not the full seed
  • Nothing stored on Vault12 servers or in the cloud

Cons

  • Guardians must install the app and stay reachable
  • Social-recovery setups need regular health checks
